prompts.text: Share something about yourself that belongs on a bingo card: a fact, habit, or skill.
Bingo square: a hidden talent nobody on the team knows.
Bingo square: your go-to weekend activity.
Bingo square: a food you could eat every day.
Bingo square: something you're weirdly good at.
Bingo square: a place you've always wanted to visit.
Bingo square: your favorite way to procrastinate.
Bingo square: a skill you learned outside of work.
Bingo square: the best advice you've ever received.
Bingo square: a movie you can quote by heart.
Bingo square: something you collect (or hoard).
Bingo square: your claim to fame, no matter how small.
